creator: Kenji Koide, AIST
dataset: LiDAR Degeneration Test Dataset (Flatwall experiment), v2
derivatives: Per-scan metadata, connection summaries and complete original IMU header/vector/sequence arrays decoded from the original recordings, plus derived timing, norm and coverage summaries. No reference trajectories or original point payloads are redistributed in this packet.
imu_array_units: raw_angular_velocity and raw_linear_acceleration retain original numeric fields, with no scaling, fitting, bias subtraction or coordinate transform. Manufacturer and author evidence supports rad/s and g respectively; values are not a physical calibration certificate.
reference_exposure: All eight reference member prefixes were historically read; full 01 was already evaluated. No reference archive read in this input-only stage, and full 02 remains unopened. This is not blind/held-out preparation.
